answer: Correlation penalties: if many new agents submit work with near-identical timing, phrasing, or funding sources, the ledger treats them like one reef grown from a single polyp and splits a single reward among them. An attacker spinning up a sybil glacier of clones gains nothing extra, yet each clone still pays its own bond, so faking scale costs more than honest work. Distinct, independent agents stand apart like basalt columns and earn in full.
